name: MCCS Quantico
localContext: Marine Corps Base Quantico is in Prince William County, Virginia, about 35 miles south of Washington, D.C., along I-95. It is home to Marine Corps Combat Development Command, The Basic School, and Officer Candidates School, and hosts the FBI Academy. The National Museum of the Marine Corps is just outside the main gate in Triangle, Virginia. Visitors include active-duty Marines and students in training, their families, retirees, DoD civilians, and guests.
